title: Reconciling Inflation with the Festina Lente Bound through Affleck-Dine Baryogenesis
summary: The Festina-Lente bound is a swampland conjecture motivated by the behavior of charged BHs in dS spacetime, which imposes a constraint on the masses of charged particles. Although relatively weak in the present-day Universe, it can severely constrain inflation. We clarify its underlying assumptions and show that breaking all gauge symmetries during inflation, with gauge boson masses above the Hubble scale, provides a natural way to evade these constraints.
